units: Targ. Y. Ex. XVI, 31; Targ. Y. Num. XI, 7 (h. text גד).—Y. Dem. I, 21ᵈ top כוסבר(ה) כוסברתא kusbar (of the Mish.) is kusbarta.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> (derisive play on the word) [read:] <he>כּוּס בְּרָה כּוּס בְּרַתָּה וכ׳</he> ‘chew the son, chew the daughter’, who classed thee among the spices?—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:2">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite> (expressing an advice symbolically = <he>כוס ברתא</he> put the daughter to death, v. <cite ref="N00837"><he>נְכַס</he></cite>; v. <cite ref="C01246"><he>גַּרְגִּילָא</he></cite>).
